Title: Submission - Knowing the Masses (disciplineless bleed for bishop/primogen)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Knowing the Masses
Cardtype: Action
Requires a titled vampire.
Bleed at +1 bleed, with an additional +1 bleed if this vampire's title is worth 1 vote.

Art notes: -

World of Darkness reference: None. Bishops and Primogen can have special knowledge no other have.
Game references: Computer Hacking, Intidimidation

How does this card address a compelling game need? Bishops and Primogen are often neglected due to their lack of votes or the cards they don't give access to. By granting them a powerful bleed action (equivalent to an Intimidation but with no discipline requirement) they can be included in decks more easily. Some independant vampires may benefit of it too (eg. Randall) but most of them already have a bleed discipline anyway.

Created by: Ankha

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Primogen/bishop don't only suffer from lack of specific cards : they also suffer from relatively big size (they are ~7.5 average while prince are a bit above 8) and if you try too much to take lower size primogen, you will end up with few common disciplines. And if you take 8-cap primogen, you would as well use prince, justicar, archbishop, cardinal, whatever.

If the card intent is to help star decks that star a bishop/primogen, let's say a Basilia wall deck or something to that extent, then the design is spot on.

If it's to give an additional edge to incite putting some more bishop / primogen in your otherwise regular crypt, then the design have the problem that you can jam on it if you didn't draw the bishop, or even if you did draw it but it's not your first vampire.

An example of something designed to be playable even with relatively few bishop / primogen would be :

Call the autority
Require a vampire with less than two votes and without ballot.
Put two token from your pool to target vampire in your uncontrolled region with exactly one vote. If this vampire is titled, you can target any vampire in your uncontrolled region. Untap this vampire. Only one Call the autority can be played each turn.

Another option would be a card which is a specific silver bullet, so you can play one or two of them, kind of an entrancement or dominate kine for bishop/primogen. The problem with an intimidation for bishop is that you are likely to want to play 5-7 of them while you're at it.
